[[File:VedoHeadquarters.jpg|thumb|right|Vedo's headquarters]]
'''Vedo Anjiliac Atirue's headquarters''' were located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. In [[137 ABY]], [[Cade Skywalker]] and the crew of the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']] went to Atirue's headquarters upon the invitation of [[Jool]]. There, Skywalker was introduced to [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]], the crime lord leader of the [[Anjiliac]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Atirue hired Skywalker's services to kill [[One Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] as retaliation for the [[Devastation of Da Soocha|destruction]] of [[Da Soocha]] and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Atirue's nephew [[Azzim Anjiliac Atirue]].<ref name="Legacy (2006) 49">[[Legacy (2006) 49|''Legacy'' (2006) 49]]</ref>

They also ran into [[Naxy Screeger]] there, who was serving as Vedo's gatekeeper. He successfully managed to separate Skywalker from [[Wolf Sazen]], [[Jariah Syn]], and [[Deliah Blue]]. An alone Skywalker was then attacked by several [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] guarding the building, but easily dispatched them with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], before meeting Vedo, who claimed it was simply to verify Skywalker's skills.
